description:
· Must have a degree in Computer Science/Engineering; advanced degree preferred; significant relevant work experience will be considered.
 · Solid knowledge and 3 years expertise in IBM ODM, Java, J2EE (WebSphere Application Server), Web Services, XML, DB (Oracle or other), Unix/Linux.
 · At least 5 years of technical expertise in the design, development, coding, testing, and debugging of Rules
 · At least 5 years of experience in rule authoring
 · At least 5 yrs of experience in development of rule engine or in complex event processing (IBM DSR, IBM DSI, JRules, iLog).
 
 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required. Will also consider one year of relevant work experience in lieu of every year of education 

 Note : NO OPT, H1 for this position 

 Client : Infosys
